relations: The dark shape at the upper-left edge drops out of frame, leaving the smashed ice cream bar undisturbed.
An abrupt cut reveals a scatter of golden snacks on the asphalt, framed by a bumper and a black tyre.
The tyre rolls leftward over the snacks, pressing them flat and snapping them apart as the bumper slides out of view.
caption: A discarded ice-cream bar lies smashed on coarse grey asphalt, its pale wooden stick jutting to the right amid cracked fragments of dark-chocolate shell and smeared white cream. The scene holds almost motionless. A dark, out-of-focus shape at the upper-left edge lingers briefly before dropping out of frame, leaving the ruined dessert undisturbed. An abrupt cut replaces that scene with a scatter of small golden breadstick-like snacks on the same asphalt, framed by a white car bumper at the left and a black tyre marked ZERO at the right. The tyre rolls steadily leftward, its silver spokes turning as the contact patch advances over the pile. Where the rubber meets the ground, the slender snacks are pressed flat and snapped apart. As the wheel continues leftward, the intact mound on the left stays in place while a growing cluster of crushed, split pieces builds on the right side of the tyre. The bumper slides out of view. The framing tightens until the silver rim and tread fill the upper frame, the crushing still underway.
